title: Photograph 1
passage: A. Someone is lifting a ring above the work surface. B. Two rings are stacked on top of each other in the front tray. C. A measuring tool is held around the outside of a metal ring. D. The jaws of the measuring tool are inside the opening of a ring.
passageZh:
A. 有人把一個環拿離工作檯面。
B. 前面的托盤裡有兩個環疊在一起。
C. 有人拿著量測工具，對準一個金屬環的外緣。
D. 量測工具的量爪伸進一個環的內孔。
